title: Live proof: a scripted seat double pauses the real wrapper, the browser says so, the pause clears and staffing resumes; runbook Provider limits
description:
SPIDR child 3d of task-ac71a55ead3d468eab7329131f04ab7e. dependsOn child 3c task-53160801515546259fecc8aa2616acce (every browser surface) AND child 2 task-4109c1a0e1154ca89576183dae7a5336 (the wrapper's pause gate, log lines, provider fallback). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 9e9b7b04.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the Playwright journey over a REAL daemon + seed + REAL wrapper, and the runbook section. No production code change; a gap found here is commented on the owning child and reported blocked with blockedOnTaskIds.

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- Lane: tests/e2e/control-room/daemon-ports.ts `withDaemonBackedControlRoom` (:452) starts apps/daemon/src/daemon-main.ts on an ephemeral port, runs the shipped seed, serves the control room through the Vite proxy; NO wrapper is started by any spec today (pairing-operator-channel.spec.ts:135-165 launches the real launcher with `MOE_AGENT_COMMAND: "node"` and an INERT stand-in wrapper). `daemonEnv` :137-150 = store trio + MOE_DAEMON_CREDENTIAL (LANE_CREDENTIAL) + MOE_NODE_SPECS_DIR; `DaemonLane` :222-251 exposes daemonOrigin, projectId, nodeRef, credential; daemon-children.ts `spawnNode`/`watch`/`killTree`/`survivingPids` (:47-160). playwright.config.ts: testMatch *.spec.ts, one worker, 180 s per test. The lane tsconfig already imports apps/daemon/src (runMoeUp), so importing child 1's `clearProviderPause` and `@moe/store`'s SqliteEventStore from the spec process is admissible.
- Wrapper binary: apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-wrapper-main.ts; env = store trio + MOE_DAEMON_CREDENTIAL + MOE_AGENT_COMMAND + MOE_WRAPPER_INTERVAL_MS (>= 100) + MOE_WRAPPER_MAX_AGENTS + MOE_WRAPPER_MAX_ITEM_ATTEMPTS (header :55-70). On win32 the spawner runs `<command> -p --setting-sources "" ... --mcp-config <file>` THROUGH cmd (agent-spawn-invocation.ts:52-60, shell:true), on posix as argv - so the seat double must be a `.cmd` (win32) / `.sh` (posix) file that IGNORES its arguments, prints the verbatim claude limit line (copied from child 1's seat-exit-classifier.test.ts fixture; never retyped) to stderr and exits 1; the spec writes it into the lane scratch dir. Child 2 resolves an unknown command's provider as "claude", so the double pauses "claude".
- The reset cannot be made short from a wall-clock line: the spec injects it with child 1's `clearProviderPause(store, projectId, "claude", now)` (a record with resetAt = now) through `SqliteEventStore.openForProject(lane store path, projectId)` from the spec process (WAL, multi-process), then waits for the wrapper's next pass.
- Runbook: docs/agent-stack-runbook.md '## Wrapper (staffs the board)' :357-378 (the idle line is documented at :371-372); the new '### Provider limits' goes right after that paragraph, before '### Git landing' (:380).

FEATURE: tests/e2e/control-room/provider-pause.spec.ts - one journey: lane up (seed SHIPPED so a READY node.deliver exists), the real wrapper spawned with the double as MOE_AGENT_COMMAND and MOE_WRAPPER_INTERVAL_MS=500, its stdout/stderr captured; assert in order: `[wrapper] <item>: SPAWNED`, `[wrapper] provider limit: claude paused until <resetAt> (<line>)`, `/health/read` (POSTed by the spec with the lane credential + protocol header) answers agents.paused within 2 s, the page shows `cr.shell.paused` with the sentence, no second SPAWNED line for 3 s; then clearProviderPause; the next `[wrapper] provider paused:` state ends and a second `[wrapper] <item>: SPAWNED` line appears within 3 passes; teardown kills the wrapper tree (survivingPids empty). Runbook '### Provider limits': the roster by provider with child 1's sample lines and their capture sources, the 30-minute default (DEFAULT_PROVIDER_PAUSE_MS), the three wrapper lines (`provider limit:`, `provider paused:`, `seat exit not recorded:`), the refund rule, where it shows in the browser (shell strip, Seats, Health, board next-step) and how to clear a pause early.
definitionOfDone: Playwright journey against a REAL daemon + seed + REAL agent-wrapper-main.ts with the scripted seat double: the wrapper log carries `SPAWNED` then `[wrapper] provider limit: claude paused until ...` (verbatim line quoted), /health/read answers `agents.paused` within 2 s, the page renders cr.shell.paused with the sentence, no second SPAWNED line within 3 s of the pause; after clearProviderPause the item is staffed again (second SPAWNED line within 3 passes); the wrapper tree is dead at teardown (survivingPids empty) - `pnpm test:e2e:browser` count line quoted with this spec listed.

The seat double is written by the spec (cmd + sh variants, platform-selected), ignores its arguments, prints the fixture line to stderr byte-for-byte (copied from child 1's fixture module, cited by path) and exits 1; the spec asserts the double's own exit code from the wrapper's `agent exited 1` line.

docs/agent-stack-runbook.md gains '### Provider limits' under '## Wrapper (staffs the board)' naming the roster with its sample lines and capture sources, DEFAULT_PROVIDER_PAUSE_MS (30 minutes), the three wrapper log lines, the attempt refund, the four browser surfaces and the early-clear recipe; `grep -n "### Provider limits" docs/agent-stack-runbook.md` = 1 hit.

Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:e2e:browser` (every pre-existing spec still green), and `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` unchanged; no production source touched (git diff --stat names only tests/e2e/control-room/** and docs/**); sources ASCII-only.
taskRails: NO PRODUCTION CHANGE: a gap in the read, the wrapper or a screen is commented on the owning child (3a/3b/3c/child 2) and this row reports blocked with blockedOnTaskIds - never patched here.

WRAPPER LANE HELPER + SEAT DOUBLE (pure parts test-first). Create tests/e2e/control-room/wrapper-lane.ts (<= 200 lines) and tests/e2e/control-room/wrapper-lane.test.ts (Node lane, `*.test.ts` so `pnpm test:e2e` runs it without a browser). Exports: `LIMIT_LINE_SOURCE = "apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/seat-exit-classifier.test.ts"` and `seatDoubleFiles(dir: string, line: string): { readonly command: string; readonly files: readonly { path: string; bytes: Uint8Array }[] }` writing THREE files into `dir`: `seat-double.js` (`process.stderr.write(Buffer.from(<JSON.stringify(line)>, "utf8") + "\n"); process.exit(1);` - the line embedded via JSON.stringify so the bytes are exact), `seat-double.cmd` (`@echo off` / `node "%~dp0seat-double.js"` / `exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%` - ignores %*; CRLF line endings), `seat-double.sh` (`#!/bin/sh` / `exec node "$(dirname "$0")/seat-double.js"`, chmod 0o755); `command` = the .cmd path on win32, the .sh path otherwise; `wrapperEnv(scratch: LaneScratch, command: string, intervalMs = 500)` = `{ ...daemonEnv(scratch), MOE_AGENT_COMMAND: command, MOE_WRAPPER_INTERVAL_MS: String(intervalMs), MOE_WRAPPER_MAX_AGENTS: "1", MOE_NODE_LANDING: "0" }` (MOE_APPROVAL_MODE etc. inherited from daemonEnv); `startWrapper(root, env, tracked): Watched` = `spawnNode(["--experimental-transform-types", `${root}/apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-wrapper-main.ts`], root, env)` pushed onto `tracked` so `withDaemonBackedControlRoom`'s teardown kills it; `clearPause(storePath, projectId, provider)` opens `SqliteEventStore.openForProject(storePath, projectId)` (import from "@moe/store"), calls child 1's `clearProviderPause(...)` with the landed signature, closes the store, returns the write's `ok`/code. Unit arms (wrapper-lane.test.ts, real temp dir, NO processes): (1) the .js file's bytes contain the JSON-escaped line and `process.exit(1)`; running it with `spawnSync(process.execPath, [jsPath])` yields status 1 and stderr byte-equal to `Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(line), Buffer.from("\n")])` - the ONE process this test spawns, because the double's bytes are the whole point; (2) on win32 `command` ends with `.cmd` and the .cmd file contains `%~dp0seat-double.js`, else `.sh` with a shebang; (3) `wrapperEnv` carries the five keys above with `MOE_WRAPPER_INTERVAL_MS: "500"` and never a claude/codex credential name (assert no key starting with ANTHROPIC_/CLAUDE_/CODEX_/OPENAI_ is ADDED beyond what daemonEnv already inherits from process.env - compare key sets). Gate: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/e2e/control-room/wrapper-lane.test.ts` from the root (count line quoted).

if that module is not importable from this tsconfig, copy the bytes into wrapper-lane.ts as `LIMIT_LINE` with a `readFileSync`-based assertion in wrapper-lane.test.ts that the copy equals the fixture's bytes); write the double into the lane scratch (`seatDoubleFiles(join(lane.repoRoot? no - the scratch root: derive it from lane.storePath's dirname), LIMIT_LINE)`); (2) start the wrapper with `startWrapper(root, wrapperEnv(scratch, command), tracked)` - `tracked` is not exposed by the lane: keep your own `ChildProcess[]` and kill it in a `finally` with `killTree` + assert `survivingPids([pid])` is empty (E2E_TEARDOWN_ORPHAN semantics reproduced locally); (3) `await wrapper.waitFor(/\[wrapper\] (node\.deliver@\S+): SPAWNED/u, 30_000)` -> the captured item equals `node.deliver@${lane.nodeRef}`; (4) `await wrapper.waitFor(/\[wrapper\] provider limit: claude paused until (\S+)/u, 15_000)` -> resetAt captured, ISO-parseable, in the future; the transcript also contains `agent exited 1` and the LIMIT_LINE bytes (teed stderr); (5) `/health/read` via the askDaemon pattern (POST `{}` with the lane headers) polled every 500 ms for <= 2 s until `body.agents.paused` is non-null -> assert `paused.provider === "claude"`, `paused.resetAt === <captured>`, `paused.lastLine === LIMIT_LINE`, `paused.workItemId === node.deliver@${lane.nodeRef}`; (6) open `lane.baseUrl` in the page, wait for the attached shell (the same readiness wait daemon-board.spec.ts uses), then `await expect(page.getByTestId("cr.shell.paused")).toHaveText(new RegExp("^Agents paused: claude limit, resumes "))`; navigate to Health (the nav rail destination daemon-board.spec / journeys.spec use) and assert `cr.health.agents` starts with "paused: claude limit"; (7) NO SECOND SEAT: wait 3 s (six passes at 500 ms) and assert the transcript holds exactly ONE `: SPAWNED` line and at least one `[wrapper] provider paused: claude until` line; (8) `clearPause(scratch.storePath, lane.projectId, "claude")` -> ok; then `await wrapper.waitFor(/\[wrapper\] (node\.deliver@\S+): SPAWNED[\s\S]*\[wrapper\] (node\.deliver@\S+): SPAWNED/u, 10_000)` (or count SPAWNED lines >= 2 within 10 s) -> the item was staffed again; planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Standing the wrapper in (as pairing-operator-channel.spec.ts does) - rejected: the parent's DoD certifies the REAL wrapper's pause; only the seat is doubled. (2) A `node` MOE_AGENT_COMMAND - rejected: the spawner appends `-p --setting-sources ...`, and `node -p` evaluates an expression; a .cmd/.sh wrapper that ignores its arguments and runs seat-double.js keeps the bytes exact through cmd.exe (echo would mangle the apostrophe and any non-ASCII byte). (3) Waiting for the real reset - impossible (wall-clock instant hours away) and a clock knob would be a wrapper change (child 2's domain); the injected reset is child 1's clearProviderPause, the same durable write an operator recipe would use. (4) A shorter interval than 500 ms - the knob floor is 100 ms but each pass reads the surface and the store; 500 ms keeps the journey under 30 s of waiting.

(2) The wrapper's standing-authority preflight prints warnings on a seeded lane (no verifier policy installed) - it still staffs; do not treat those lines as failure.
